_readme: Test fixture, not calendar data. The event calendar index.test.ts hands the pricing boot through PRICING_EVENTS_PATH, so the test never reads the live ops/markets/events.json. Every ticker here is in fixtures/registry-v2.json (AAPL, NVDA, SGOV, TSLA): pricing/events.ts refuses a ticker the registry does not list, and the live file's SPCX would make the boot tests red. recheckBy is far in the future so /health never reads it as overdue.
